# Astryx Dracula Theme

> Pure Dracula brand kit for Astryx React sites. Dark-only tokens, syntax highlighting, and chart colors with prebuilt CSS and zero runtime cost.

Use the links below to style a site with this theme or migrate a codebase to it. Start with the agent skill, then the usage guide.

## Start here

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuzu-octopus/astryx-theme/main/.agents/skills/astryx-styles/SKILL.md): Exact token names, new-site steps, migration steps, common mistakes.
- [Usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuzu-octopus/astryx-theme/main/USAGE.md): Prebuilt, runtime, and plain-CSS paths plus Vite setup.
- [Brand reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuzu-octopus/astryx-theme/main/BRAND.md): Frozen palette, semantic map, charts, code highlighting, deliberate neutrals.

## Theme source

- [Theme definition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuzu-octopus/astryx-theme/main/astryx-theme.ts): defineTheme source with all token overrides.
- [Plain CSS tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuzu-octopus/astryx-theme/main/tokens.css): :root fallbacks and font declarations.
- [Token source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuzu-octopus/astryx-theme/main/tokens.json): Single source of primitives and dims.

## Optional

- [Live showcase](https://yuzu-octopus.github.io/astryx-theme/): Overview, component gallery, dashboard, and quickstart.
- [Dracula spec](https://draculatheme.com/contribute): Official palette this theme freezes.
